metadata.case_name: YIP KIN FUN v. LAU HON KIT

source: After X-ray, the diagnosis was closed fractured left superior pubic ramus and fractured (6th to 8th) ribs.

injuries.description: closed fractured left superior pubic ramus
source: After X-ray, the diagnosis was closed fractured left superior pubic ramus and fractured (6th to 8th) ribs.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

manifestations.description: reduced lifting capacity from floor to knuckle level (about half of required weight)
reduced sexual activity (refused sex most of the time)

treatments_received.treatment: conservative treatment including analgesic and physiotherapy
source: She was given conservative treatment including analgesic and physiotherapy. No surgery was carried out. She was discharged 5 days later.

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy: pain relief with hot pad to the left trapezius and left chest wall, pain relief to the left shoulder, leg strengthening exercises, shoulder mobilising exercises, upper limb strengthening exercises and manual therapy to the neck
source: The treatment included pain relief with hot pad to the left trapezius and left chest wall, pain relief to the left shoulder, leg strengthening exercises, shoulder mobilising exercises, upper limb strengthening exercises and manual therapy to the neck.

treatments_received.treatment: occupational therapy: work assessment and hardening exercise; rehabilitation course; attended 14 sessions of occupational therapy
source: The hospital’s occupational therapy report recorded that Yip was referred for work assessment and hardening exercise in late August 2006.

Rehabilitation course was designed for her. During the re-assessment in early October 2006, Yip demonstrated her capacity to lift and to carry weight matched the pre-accident job demand marginally. She was advised to try to resume work. By then, she had attended 14 sessions of occupational therapy.
For complaint about elbow pain, she had received another 7 sessions of physiotherapy to her elbows before again defaulting the last appointment in May 2008.

treatments_received.treatment: referral to clinical psychologist for care and assessment
source: Yip has also been referred to the clinical psychologist for care and assessment in February 2008. Due to her attempt to resume work, her sessions were spaced out to October 2008.

treatments_future.treatment: intensive course of 15 sessions by a clinical psychologist
source: The experts recommended an intensive course of 15 sessions by a clinical psychologist to help enhance Yip’s ability to cope with the stressors and pain; and to help alleviate her depressed mood.

losses.description: marital relationship became more strained and cold; lack of support from husband; distressed by lack of support

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Due to the pain, she refused sex with her husband most of the time.
She had limited social life, feeling anxious and depressed.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She had to tolerate a low standard of hygiene condition at home for fear of over-exertion and possible deterioration of her conditions.
Mood depression and adjustment disorder; lowered sense of worth and dignity; increased loneliness and limited social activities.
Disadvantaged in the labour market; award for loss of earning capacity made.
